name: Club application PDF
prompt: Fill the application PDF at {root}/form.pdf with the facts in {root}/facts.md, in the order given, and save it at {target}. Use the email of record from the facts. Show the filled fields.
claim: The PDF is filled from the facts file in the given order, saved in the clubs folder.
rubric: Schools and dates appear in the order the facts file gives.
The email of record matches the facts file.
Every filled field matches the facts file word for word.
The filled PDF is saved in the members clubs folder.
The reply lists the filled fields as evidence.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
